scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to the
Einbroch Airport,
where we offer nonstop
flights to the cities of
Juno, Lighthalzen and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
欢迎来到艾音布罗克机场，
我们提供前往朱诺、
里希塔乐镇和毁葛的
直达航班。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
The Airship boarding fee
is 1,200 zeny, but if you've
got a Free Ticket for Airship,
the fee will be waived. Will
you board the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
搭乘飞空艇的费用为
1,200 泽尼，但如果您持有
飞空艇免费券，则无需付费。
请问您要搭乘飞空艇吗？

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have a Free Ticket for
Airship and you don't have
enough zeny for boarding
the Airship. Remember, the
boarding fee is 1,200 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
很抱歉，您既没有
飞空艇免费券，也没有足够的
泽尼来支付搭乘费用。
请记住，搭乘费用为
1,200 泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
谢谢，祝您
生活愉快。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Welcome to Einbroch Airport.
If you are arriving from your
flight, let me guide you to the
main terminal. Otherwise, please board the Airship to depart to
Juno, Lighthalzen and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
欢迎来到艾音布罗克机场。
如果您是刚下飞机，请让我
引导您前往主航站楼。
否则，请搭乘飞空艇前往
朱诺、里希塔乐镇和毁葛。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Once you're in the main terminal, you will need to pay the fee again
to board an Airship. You should
only exit if the city of Einbroch
is your intended destination.
Proceed to the main terminal?
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
到达主航站楼后，您需要
再次支付费用才能搭乘飞空艇。
只有当艾音布罗克是您的
目的地时才建议离开。
确定前往主航站楼吗？

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Alright, thank you
for your patronage
and I hope you have
a pleasant flight~
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
好的，感谢您的光临，
祝您旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome to the
Einbroch Airport.
Please use this door to
board the Airship which stops
over Juno, Lighthalzen and
Hugel in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎来到艾音布罗克机场。
请通过此门搭乘飞空艇，
本航线将停靠于修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德
共和国境内的朱诺、
里希塔乐镇和毁葛。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Otherwise, if Einbroch is
your intended destination,
please head down the stairs
and ask the Arrival Staff to lead
you to the main terminal. Thank
you, and enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
否则，如果艾音布罗克是
您的目的地，请下楼并
询问到达区工作人员，
由他们引导您前往主航站楼。
谢谢，祝您旅途愉快。
